description: This Java class defines a test scenario for policy enforcement in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements the Scenario4MultipleSubjects interface and sets up specific permissions for a test subject, then applies a policy algorithm to verify access rights in a resource hierarchy.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects17
classes.description: A test scenario class that sets up permissions for a specific subject and applies a policy algorithm to verify resource access permissions in a hierarchy.
